name: 97370 · Philomath, OR
findings: ZIP 97370 (Philomath) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 9 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97370 (Philomath) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97370 (Philomath) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97370 (Philomath) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
